scope: Internal Kalama system-language meaning for Patch Assist fields. Contains no remediation evidence, no case facts, no CVE facts, no URLs. Must be used alongside — never merged into — a remediation Evidence Pack.

A.name: source build
A.meaning: The vulnerable component is a language/ecosystem package built from source; remediation rebuilds it (Maven first).
A.selection_rule: Select A when the occurrence routes to the source-build provider: scanner result_class lang-pkgs, or result_type in {jar, javapkg, pom, maven}.
provenance: src/kalama/remediation/models.py:40 (Fix type A denotes a source build)
docs/LAB_CASES.md:27-35 (FixType A Maven source build lab case)

B.name: prebuilt image
B.meaning: The vulnerable component is delivered as a prebuilt image artifact; remediation replaces the image rather than rebuilding or package-upgrading.
B.selection_rule: Select B when discovery classifies the candidate PREBUILT_IMAGE (uniform prebuilt classification across occurrences).

C.name: OS package
C.meaning: The vulnerable component is an operating-system package managed by the image package manager; remediation upgrades it via the package manager, executable only when the exact fixed version is proven available through a non-mutating package-manager query (a scanner FixedVersion alone is not proof of installability).
C.selection_rule: Select C when the occurrence routes to the OS-package provider: scanner result_class os-pkgs, or result_type in {debian, ubuntu, alpine, rpm, rhel, centos, fedora, redhat, deb, apk}; package manager mapping deb/debian/ubuntu->apt, alpine/apk->apk, rpm-family->dnf.
provenance: docs/LAB_CASES.md:6-14 (FixType C OS package lab case)

retired_or_out_of_scope.D: No FixType D exists in the production enum (remediation/models.py:10-13 defines A/B/C only). A case_id D in evaluation/llm_eval_cases.py:196-270 is an unrelated attack-case label, not a fix type. Do not propose D.

compatibility_rules.rule: HUMAN_COMMAND allowed with any fix type

build_system_semantics.meaning: build_system applies only to source-build (FixType A) remediation; the only value deterministic discovery emits is maven. Non-source-build candidates carry no build system.

usage_constraint: This contract supplies system-language meaning only. Every factual remediation claim (versions, artifacts, hashes, dependencies, procedures) must still cite the Evidence Pack. The contract never overrides evidence-sufficiency gates and never asserts remediation success.
